nodes.summary: Search the web. Returns ranked results with title, URL, date and a summary written for a model to read. Use it to check a fact instead of answering from memory; follow up with web_fetch for a full page.

text.description: Structured search results (numbered list with titles + URLs) + AI summary

side_effects: makes a POST to the DeepSeek Search API

nodes.summary: Read one web page. Default readable mode returns clean Markdown from the DeepSeek Fetch API (falling back to a local GET that strips HTML, max 8000 chars). Set raw: true to skip the vendor and get the untouched HTTP response body (the HTML source, no tag stripping) — use it for image URLs (), tags and JSON-LD that extraction drops. Raw mode has no character cut: it returns the whole body and lets result spilling handle size; only a 16 MiB memory cap refuses outright. Only http/https allowed; private addresses are refused.

raw.description: Return the untouched response body (HTML source) instead of extracted Markdown. Use it to read URLs, tags or JSON-LD that readable mode strips.

mode.description: Which mode produced text: extracted Markdown or the raw response body

side_effects: makes a POST to the DeepSeek Fetch API in readable mode; raw mode makes only a local HTTP GET
